title: Communication Style Test
description: Explore your communication style pattern with practical, scenario-based questions.
instructions: Answer from recent real behavior, not an ideal version of yourself.
If a statement reminds you of a concrete situation, it is usually more useful.
Use the result for reflection and communication, not as a diagnosis.

scaleQuestions.question: In recent real situations, I can see a clear Assertive pattern in how I choose and act.
When pressure rises, I often rely on a Assertive strategy instead of switching styles.
People who work with me would probably notice my Assertive tendency.
If an environment blocks Assertive for too long, my motivation drops.
During collaboration, I often bring Assertive into the way I contribute.
Looking back over the last month, Assertive describes a repeated behavior pattern for me.

ASSERTIVE.title: Assertive
ASSERTIVE.summary: In this Communication Style Test, your result is Assertive. Your answers cluster around the behaviors, needs, or reactions represented by this pattern.
strengths: You can create leverage in tasks that reward Assertive
You tend to build repeatable strategies
You notice the cues that affect your performance
weaknesses: Under pressure, you may overuse one strategy
Opposite perspectives can be easy to miss
The result should guide you rather than limit you
careers: Find the situations that trigger this pattern
Choose tasks that fit the tendency
relationships: Explain your need for Assertive clearly while leaving room for other people's pace and style.
growthPlan: Track the pattern for one week
Practice the new move in a low-risk situation
